jurisdiction.ui_help: Choose the office responsible for where you live; the current 2026 intake status differs by jurisdiction.

options.label: Spain except Catalonia, Balearic Islands, Canary Islands and Valencian Community
options.mission_label: Embassy of Japan in Spain — Madrid
options.mission_detail: Madrid handles residents outside the Barcelona and Canary jurisdictions. Applications are in person by appointment.

application_status.label: Madrid 2026 Working Holiday quota exhausted
application_status.detail: The Embassy's 28 August 2026 Working Holiday notice says its 2026 quota is exhausted and that 2027 applications can be submitted from 1 December 2026.

options.label: Catalonia, Balearic Islands or Valencian Community
options.mission_detail: Barcelona handles Catalonia, the Balearic Islands and the Valencian Community.

application_status.label: Barcelona reported 2026 quota available on 16 September
application_status.detail: The latest Barcelona Working Holiday page found during verification, dated 16 September 2026, reported its 2026 quota available. Recheck immediately before applying because its allocated quota can close.

options.label: Canary Islands

options.mission_detail: Las Palmas handles residents of the Canary Islands; an appointment is required for consular visits.

application_status.label: Confirm Canary Islands quota before applying
application_status.detail: The current Las Palmas consular page confirms a separate Working Holiday service and Canary Islands jurisdiction, but this verification did not find a current 2026 quota-status notice. Confirm directly before applying.

options.label: I am not resident in Spain

options.mission_detail: The current Spanish Working Holiday route requires Spanish citizenship and residence in Spain when applying.
options.issue: The Spain Working Holiday route requires the applicant to be a Spanish citizen resident in Spain at the time of application.

document_checklist.title: Valid Spanish passport
document_checklist.description: Original Spanish passport with at least two blank pages and at least one year validity from arrival in Japan.

document_checklist.title: Completed visa application form
document_checklist.description: Complete the current application form and sign it by hand as instructed.

document_checklist.title: Recent visa photograph
document_checklist.description: 35mm × 45mm photo taken within the previous six months, following the current photo specification.

document_checklist.title: Current CV
document_checklist.description: Prepare the current CV format covering personal, education and employment history.

document_checklist.title: Detailed monthly activity plan
document_checklist.description: Prepare a realistic monthly itinerary explaining the locations and activities planned in Japan.

document_checklist.title: Working Holiday motivation statement
document_checklist.description: Write at least one A4 page explaining why you chose Japan and what you expect from the experience.

document_checklist.title: Recent medical certificate
document_checklist.description: Provide the current required medical evidence issued within the specified recent period.

document_checklist.title: Criminal-record declaration
document_checklist.description: Complete the current sworn declaration regarding criminal history.

document_checklist.title: Recent bank balance certificate
document_checklist.description: Use the applicable €2,000 / €3,000 / €4,000 threshold according to the flight booking you submit.

document_checklist.title: Flight booking evidence where applicable
document_checklist.description: Provide the flight evidence corresponding to the funds tier used in your application.

preparation_checklist.title: Confirm Madrid, Barcelona or Las Palmas jurisdiction
preparation_checklist.description: Your place of residence determines the Japanese office that can accept the application.

preparation_checklist.title: Check your office's current quota status
preparation_checklist.description: 2026 availability is jurisdiction-specific and can change as each allocated quota fills.

preparation_checklist.title: Follow your office's current appointment procedure
preparation_checklist.description: Madrid and Las Palmas require appointments; verify Barcelona's current submission instructions before attending.

preparation_checklist.title: Match bank balance to your flight evidence
preparation_checklist.description: The current funds threshold changes between round-trip, one-way and no-flight-reservation applications.

preparation_checklist.title: Run a final official-source check
preparation_checklist.description: Recheck quota, documents and submission instructions immediately before applying.
